name: IBY_PMT_CREATION_RULES_
description: IBY_PMT_CREATION_RULES specifies how documents payable are grouped into payments. Creation rules are determined by payment process profiles. This table corresponds to the Payment Creation tab of the Update Payment Process Profile page.

columns.name: SYSTEM_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Unique primary key

columns.name: GROUP_BY_ULTIMATE_DEBTOR
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for ultimate debtor.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_DETAILS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for payment details.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for bank charge bearer.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_DELIVERY_CHANNEL
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for delivery channel.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_REMITTANCE_MESSAGE
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for remittance message.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_MAX_DOCUMENTS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether there is a limit on the number of documents payable that can be grouped into one payment.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_UNIQUE_REMIT_ID_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for unique remittance identifier.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_SETTLE_PRIORITY_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for settlement priority.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_REASON
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for payment reason.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_DUE_DATE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for due date.

columns.name: MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_PAYMENT
columns.description: Maximum number of documents that can be grouped into a single payment. This value will only be used if GROUP_BY_MAX_DOCUMENTS_FLAG is set to Y.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DETAILS_LENGTH_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum length of the payment detail record. Typically, this is a type of description record in a payment format that allows concatenated details of the payment to be included, for example, invoice numbers. If this length is exceeded, then the payment will be split into multiple payments.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DETAILS_FORMULA
columns.description: SQL function to be used to concatenate the document attributes into the payment details information

columns.name: GROUP_BY_INVOICING_ORG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable should be built into separate payments when they have different values for invoicing business unit.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
